title: प्रबन्ध वक्रताका आधारमा खै–खै निबन्धको विश्लेषण Prabandha Wakratakaa Aadharma Khai Khai Nibandhako Vishleshan
nepali: आचार्य कुन्तकको वक्रोक्ति सिद्धान्त पूर्वीय समालोचना सिद्धान्तमध्ये समन्वयवादी सिद्धान्तका रूपमा रहेको छ । वस्तुगत तथ्यमा आधारित रहेर काव्य रचनाको विश्लेषण गरिने भएकाले वक्रोक्ति सिद्धान्तको पाश्चात्य समालोचना सिद्धान्त शैलीविज्ञानसँग सामञ्जस्यता रहेको देखिन्छ । वक्रोक्ति सिद्धान्तमा आधारित भएर कुनै पनि कृतिमा भाषाको सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ वर्णदेखि क्रमशः पद, वाक्य, प्रकरण हुँदै भाषाको सबैभन्दा ठूलो एकाइ प्रबन्ध वा सङ्कथन सम्मको विश्लेषण गर्न सकिन्छ । नेपाली साहित्यमा केशवराज पिंडाली एक सशक्त हास्यव्यङ्य निबन्धकारका रूपमा देखिन्छन् । उनको कलम उपन्यास, कथा, निबन्ध आदिमा चलेको भए पनि पिंडाली सर्वाधिक सफल निबन्धमै देखिन्छन् । वर्णविन्यास वक्रतादेखि प्रबन्ध वक्रतासम्मको सफल प्रस्तुति रहेका उनका निबन्धहरू उक्तिवैचित्र्यता युक्त छन् ।
american_english: Acharya Kuntaka’s Vakrokti theory stands as a coordinative theory among the Eastern theories of literary criticism. Because it analyzes literary composition on the basis of objective facts, the Vakrokti theory is seen to have a correspondence with the Western literary criticism theory of stylistics. On the basis of the Vakrokti theory, any work can be analyzed from the smallest unit of language, the letter, successively through the word, sentence, and episode, up to the largest unit of language, the composition or narrative. In Nepali literature, Keshavraj Pindali appears as a powerful writer of humorous and satirical essays. Although his pen moved in novels, stories, essays, and other forms, Pindali is seen to be most successful in essays. His essays, which contain successful presentations ranging from phonetic artistry to compositional artistry, are endowed with strikingness of expression.

informal_english: Acharya Kuntaka’s Vakrokti theory is basically a coordinative theory among the Eastern theories of literary criticism. Since it analyses literary composition on the basis of objective facts, you can see that the Vakrokti theory matches up well with the Western literary criticism theory of stylistics. On the basis of the Vakrokti theory, you can analyse any work right from the smallest unit of language, the letter, going step by step through the word, sentence and episode, all the way up to the largest unit of language, the composition or narrative. In Nepali literature, Keshavraj Pindali comes across as a strong writer of humorous and satirical essays. Even though he tried his hand at novels, stories, essays and other forms, Pindali is actually most successful in essays. His essays, which have successful presentations ranging from phonetic artistry to compositional artistry, are full of strikingness of expression.
translator_notes: Key terms such as वक्रोक्ति (Vakrokti), प्रबन्ध वक्रता (compositional artistry), वर्णविन्यास वक्रता (phonetic artistry), and उक्तिवैचित्र्य (strikingness of expression) were rendered to reflect their technical literary-critical senses while preserving the source sentence order.
